# Contributing

## Getting Started

1. Clone the repo and install dependencies: `bun install`
2. Run tests: `bun test`
3. Full validation before PR: `bun validate`

## Testing

```bash
bun test              # Unit tests (src/)
bun test:e2e          # E2E tests (test/e2e/)
bun test:all          # All tests
bun typecheck         # TypeScript check
bun format            # Format with Prettier
```
